source: Onkelos on Exod 35:30-33; the appointment protocol at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 3:2 with 3:1
claim_en: SEE, the LORD has EXALTED BY NAME Bezalel — the naming re-announced to the PEOPLE, the endowment upgraded to a spirit of PROPHECY from before the LORD (Onkelos Exod 35). The spine records the audit-charge: Moses is king, Aaron high priest, his sons deputies, Eleazar chief, the Kohathites bearers — and now the works contract to the kinsman! — and the answer: 'I did nothing of my own,' AND HE SHOWS THEM THE VERSE (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 3:2); Moses himself learned the builder's name only at handoff, having thought every THOU-SHALT-MAKE meant him (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 3:1). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 35:31; the precondition at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 2:1
claim_en: He filled him with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge — and the lady's question (why not give wisdom to FOOLS?) is answered from her own lending desk: one lends to the rich who can repay — He giveth wisdom TO THE WISE (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 2:1): the grant's precondition is prior capacity, the shopkeeper refilling each bottle by what it already smells of. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

AND TO TEACH He put in his heart — he and Oholiab of Dan — and the received translation converts even the design-vocabulary to pedagogy: 'to devise designs' rendered to TEACH CRAFTSMANSHIP at 35:32, 'the designers' rendered TEACHERS OF CRAFTSMANSHIP at 35:35 (Onkelos Exod 35): the master-craftsman's office is a teaching office at both ends of the span (EX31-01's seat confirmed and extended at the execution side).

source: Onkelos on Exod 36:1-4; the toolchain identity at Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 5:1 with 5:2, 4:7, 4:10, and 4:6
claim_en: Every wise-hearted man in whom the LORD put wisdom and understanding takes the materials, each man from his task (Onkelos Exod 36) — and the spine states the identity: wisdom, understanding, knowledge are the THREE ATTRIBUTES BY WHICH THE WORLD WAS CREATED (the LORD by wisdom founded the earth), and with the same three the tabernacle was built (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 5:1) — as the Temple after it and the house to come: one toolchain, four builds (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 5:2). Wisdom granted to ALL the workers — the ink pressed to include even the beasts (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 4:7); the merit lines ride: Hur's martyrdom paid in the grandson's commission (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 4:6), Miriam's midwife-wisdom the mother-line (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 4:10). Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

source: Onkelos on Exod 36:5-7; the two-mornings count at Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:4; the docket row Mishnah Shevuot 1:1
claim_en: The craftsmen report upward — the people bring TOO MUCH; Moses orders a herald through the camp: let no man or woman do any more work for the sacred offering — AND THE PEOPLE STOPPED; and the audit line closes the intake: ENOUGH for all the work, AND SOME LEFT OVER (Onkelos Exod 36). R. Yohanan counts the whole intake at TWO MORNINGS from the doubled morning-word (Midrash Tanchuma, Pekudei 5:4). The case shelf hangs the CARRYING labor from this very stop order — the camp-wide ban on bringing from the tents is the Sabbath carrying-out's derivation anchor (Mishnah Shevuot 1:1, this exam's docket).

claim_en: The planks STANDING upright (Onkelos Exod 36) — the held-as-they-grow token executed; the spine adds two laws on the species and the name: the King to whom all belongs built from NON-fruit-bearing acacia — how much more must a man spare fruit trees (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 9:1); and the building's name read as PLEDGE — if Israel incurs guilt the tabernacle is seized as their collateral, and when no house stands, the righteous are taken as the pledge (Midrash Tanchuma, Vayakhel 9:2). source: Onkelos on Exod 36:35-38; the veil's spec-sheet at Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 10:1; the case numbers at Mishnah Shekalim 8:4
claim_en: The dividing veil made — craftsman's work with cherubim, the embroiderer's screen at the door: two textile grades, inside and threshold (Onkelos Exod 36). And the Buber recension recites the case shelf's spec-sheet INTO the reading: a handbreadth thick, woven on SEVENTY-TWO warps at TWENTY-FOUR threads each, forty cubits by twenty, no knots, two made yearly, THREE HUNDRED priests to immerse it (Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Vayakhel 10:1 — the Temple-veil table of Mishnah Shekalim 8:4 and its neighbor), with the Buber-only order note that MOSES made the veil before Bezalel took the ark. Numeric claims opened in full. Seated under the amended spine, auto-seat law.

THE PROCLAMATION'S TWO EXPORTS. R. Yochanan: WHERE IS CARRYING-OUT WRITTEN? In this verse's 'and they passed a proclamation through the camp' — Moses in the Levites' camp (the public domain) barring carriage from the private camps. The Shabbat-day proof by passing-passing to the Jubilee shofar (Lev 25:9, a banned-labor day both); and the SAME analogy runs back — the shofar's passing learns from Moses to be WITH A VOICE: this verse the fixed end of both directions. The Kehat riders: carrying above ten handbreadths liable (the ten-cubit boards, the pole-load's third); the typical-manner gate (right, left, lap, shoulder — as Kehat; backhanded exempt). EX36-05 hung the labor on the stop order before the sugya opened. Filed F-064, auto-seated (round 17).
